note: One general line per storm strength, read on the 'What the real storm did' card in Time Machine. Team may edit the wording.
weak: A smaller storm. It made the sky glow near the poles on Earth.
medium: A strong storm. It can make bright lights in the sky and bother radios.
strong: A giant storm. Storms like this can knock out radios and light up the sky far from the poles.
